name: fievel
description: Build and improve a portable content system with guided workflows and local quality checks.

interface.longDescription: Build content standards, AI behavior rules, source records and quality checks as portable files you own, with guided workflows and local validation. Requires Python 3.10+ and jsonschema.
defaultPrompt: Start Fievel and help me build my content system.

publication.release_notes: Six guided skills for building a portable content system: getting started, content standards, sources, AI behavior, evaluations and audits. Local Python tools validate your files, run saved-response checks and generate a read-only viewer. Your project stays in your own folder.
